newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ADI, Lockheed unit win U.S. army tank deal.
newsitem.headline: ADI, Lockheed unit win U.S. army tank deal.

text.p: Australian government arms maker ADI Ltd said on Wednesday it had teamed with a unit of Lockheed Martin Corp to win a multi-million dollar tank training systems contract with the United States army.
ADI said in a statement it would supply a projectile location system, which would be incorporated into Lockheed Martin Tactical Defence Systems' integrated tank target system.
No figure was given for the value of the contract.
ADI Managing Director Ken Harris said the system would be installed in 45 army bases in the United States.
"We are confident the contract will generate further training system sales in the U.S. and we are already looking at further opportunities with Lockheed Martin," Harris said.
An ADI spokesman was not immediately available to give details on when the contract would begin or how long it would last.
